label: Rate type
definition: Fixed, floating, hybrid or another rate structure for the mapped loan or facility and stated effective period.
notes: A fixed/floating label does not establish the current coupon, benchmark, spread, floor, cap or future step schedule.

label: Reference rate
definition: Stable identity of the benchmark to which the mapped floating-rate term refers.
notes: Aliases are search suggestions only. SOFR method/tenor must remain explicit. Prime is not automatically an agreement-defined Base Rate or ABR.

label: Reference-rate tenor
definition: Tenor explicitly applicable to the mapped reference rate.
notes: Do not infer tenor from a generic SOFR, LIBOR or Euribor label.

label: Reference-rate method
definition: Term, daily-simple, compounded-in-arrears or another method explicitly applicable to the mapped reference rate.
notes: Lookback, observation shift, publication lag and other agreement terms are not implied by these broad method codes.

label: Contractual spread or margin
definition: Contractual additive margin over the mapped reference rate for the stated loan or facility and effective period, normalized to basis points only after meaning and units are established.
notes: Do not map discount margin, yield spread, OID, fees or an all-in coupon to this field without source confirmation.

label: Reference-rate value
definition: Observed numeric value of the mapped reference rate for the stated observation or as-of date.
notes: This is a supplied observation, not an automatically retrieved market rate. Preserve its source and date.

label: Stated coupon rate
definition: Rate identified by the source as coupon for the mapped loan or facility, without silently assuming whether it is current, contractual, cash, PIK or total coupon.
notes: Use a component-specific field when the source establishes cash, PIK or total coupon. Coupon is not yield or spread.

label: Cash coupon rate
definition: Coupon component explicitly payable in cash for the mapped period and scope.
notes: Do not infer this component by subtracting an unlabeled PIK rate from an unlabeled coupon.

label: PIK coupon rate
definition: Coupon component explicitly payable in kind for the mapped period and scope.
notes: A permitted PIK option is not necessarily the PIK component currently in effect.

label: Total coupon rate
definition: Combined coupon rate explicitly represented by the source as including all applicable cash and PIK components for the mapped period.
notes: Do not calculate this field until the included components and effective terms are established.

label: Reference-rate floor
definition: Minimum reference-rate value explicitly applicable before the contractual spread or margin is added.
notes: Keep distinct from a floor applied to the all-in coupon.

label: Reference-rate cap
definition: Maximum reference-rate value explicitly applicable before the contractual spread or margin is added.
notes: Keep distinct from a cap applied to the all-in coupon.

label: Coupon-rate floor
definition: Minimum all-in coupon rate explicitly applicable to the mapped loan or facility.
notes: Do not substitute a reference-rate floor for this field.

label: Coupon-rate cap
definition: Maximum all-in coupon rate explicitly applicable to the mapped loan or facility.
notes: Do not substitute a reference-rate cap for this field.

label: Yield rate
definition: Yield value for the separately established yield measure, valuation inputs and as-of date.
notes: An unlabeled yield is not interchangeable with coupon or contractual spread. Phase 1 preserves supplied yield values and does not calculate yield.

label: Yield measure
definition: Exact type of yield represented by the mapped yield value.
notes: A generic Yield header does not establish this field's value.

label: Rate as-of date
definition: Date to which an observed coupon, reference-rate value or yield relates, as stated by the source.
notes: Do not substitute the file modification date, application session date or reporting date unless the source establishes equivalence.

label: Rate effective date
definition: Date on which the mapped contractual rate term or component becomes effective, as stated by the source.
notes: Keep distinct from observation, reset, payment, reporting and amendment dates unless the source establishes equivalence.
